xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes:
(1) The above financial results for the Second Quarter and Half-year ended September 30, 2026 in respect of TTK Healthcare Limited (the Company) have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their respective meetings held on October 30, 2026 at the Registered Office of the Company, also with the provision of Video Conferencing facility.
(2) The Statutory Auditors of the Company have carried out Limited Review of the above Unaudited Financial Results in terms of Regulations 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
(3) During the Fourth Quarter of FY 2024-25, the Company had written off the entire value of Male Contraceptives pertaining to Protective Devices Division amounting to Rs.586.39 lakhs that were meant for export under USAID Program, owing to 90-day pause on foreign development assistance and subsequent cancellation of Purchase Orders. This write off was shown as Exceptional Item during FY 2024-25.
In the First Half of this financial year, the Company has received orders for inventory amounting to Rs.552.58 lakhs, which were written off in FY 2024-25. The Company has invoiced inventory amounting to Rs.509.92 lakhs for a selling value of Rs.701.85 lakhs in First Quarter of this year and inventory amounting to Rs.42.66 lakhs for a selling value of Rs.52.30 lakhs in Second Quarter of this year to USAID, which are included in the revenue of the Company .
(4)(i) Exceptional Items pertaining to the current year:
During the Quarter, based on definitive agreement entered into with M/s Wipro Enterprises Private Limited on July 23, 2026 for sale of the Company’s "EVA" and "GoodHome" brands and related assets, the Company received consideration of Rs.25,600 lakhs plus applicable GST on September 04, 2026 and the transaction was completed. The Company recognized a net gain of Rs.24,820.03 lakhs during the quarter, after considering transaction-related and other directly attributable costs.
Further, inventories aggregating to Rs.1,650.15 lakhs were transferred to the buyer at cost as part of the Asset Purchase Agreement, and the sale of such inventories has been recognized as revenue during the quarter.
(ii) Exceptional Items pertaining to the previous year:
(a) On November 21, 2025, the Government of India notified the four Labour Codes, consolidating 29 existing labour laws, and the Ministry of Labour & Employment subsequently issued draft Central Rules and FAQs. Based on the best information available and in line with the guidance issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, the Company had assessed the incremental impact arising from the change in the definition of wages and, considering its material, regulatory-driven and non-recurring nature, had presented the same as Exceptional items in the Statement of Profit and Loss for the previous year ended March 31, 2026.
The incremental impact comprised Gratuity of Rs.823.02 lakhs and Long-term Compensated Absences of Rs.284.85 lakhs, against which the provision of Rs.350 lakhs created in FY 2020–21 was adjusted, resulting in a net charge of Rs.757.87 lakhs being recognized in the previous financial year.
(b) The Company has recognised Rs.350.42 lakhs as exceptional income during the fourth quarter of the previous year towards GST refund relating to earlier periods, which was received subsequently.
(5) The tax relating to earlier years represents the tax refund relating to AY 2016-17 and AY 2017-18 received, consequent to completion of assessments.
(6) The Company does not have any Subsidiary / Associate / Joint Venture Company(ies) as on September 30, 2026.
(7) The previous period's / year's figures have been regrouped and reclassified, wherever necessary to conform to the current period's / year's presentation.
(8) This statement is also available on the website of BSE Limited (www.bseindia.com), National Stock Exchange of India Limited (www.nseindia.com) and also on the website of the Company (www.ttkhealthcare.com).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsExp:
(1) Segments have been identified in line with the Indian Accounting Standard on Segment Reporting (Ind AS 108) based on review of performance by the Top Management.
(2) Details of products included in each of the Segments are as below :
i) Animal Welfare comprise products for Veterinary use.
ii) The Consumer Products segment comprises the marketing and distribution of Woodward’s Gripe Water. It also included the EVA range of cosmetics and the Good Home range of scrubbers, air fresheners and related products until the sale of these brands. The revenues and results of these businesses are included in the segment only up to the date of sale. Certain assets and liabilities relating to these businesses remain included in the segment pending their collection, realisation or settlement, as applicable.
iii) Medical Devices include Artificial Heart Valves, Orthopaedic Implants, etc.
iv) Protective Devices comprise manufacturing and marketing of Male Contraceptives and other allied products.
v) Foods comprise manufacturing and marketing of Food Products.
vi) "Others" include Printing and Publishing of Maps and Atlases.
(3) The segment wise revenue, results, assets and liabilities figures relate to respective amounts directly identifiable to each of the segments. The unallocable expenditure includes expenses incurred on common services at the corporate level and also those expenses not identifiable to any specific segment.
(4) The previous period's / year's figures have been regrouped and reclassified, wherever necessary to conform to the current period's / year's presentation.
